text_block_list.text:
On our day off,
I took Shinko Windy to the zoo.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Crocodiles! Hippos! Gorillas!
C'mon, c'mon,
let's hurry up and see 'em all!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Every single one of 'em has top-tier bite
power!
Feeding time is an absolute must-see!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, move it, move it!
We gotta catch 'em in action when they're
at their fiercest!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Uooooooh! Check that out!
Look at the power on that croc!
Chomping down with those massive jaws!

text_block_list.name: Visitor A
text_block_list.text:
Look at those wicked teeth~!
Getting bitten by that would take your arm
clean off~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Muu.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...If Windy-chan bit you,
it'd be way crazier than that!

text_block_list.name: Visitor A
text_block_list.text:
The way it chomps with that big mouth is so
cute too~!

text_block_list.name: Visitor B
text_block_list.text:
Look at how it stands in the water~. 
That's pretty darn cute too~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Mumumu! 
Only paying attention to them isn't fair at
all!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to biting power,
Windy-chan's got plenty too...!

Shinko Windy's mood was steadily
deteriorating. 
At this rate, things could get ugly...!

text_block_list.name: Zookeeper
text_block_list.text:
Goat King,
looks like not many visitors came to see
you today either.

text_block_list.name: Goat King
text_block_list.text: Meeeeh...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...What's that? 
He's taking a goat for a walk.

text_block_list.name: Zookeeper
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha...
Feel free to play with him if you'd like.
He's really sweet, 
but he just hasn't gotten much attention
lately...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Hey you, come with me for a sec.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
And do this, then that, 
and for the finishing touch...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Na-ha-ha-ha! How's that?! 
I braided his beard into a triple braid!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmph!
You can't get any attention looking all lame
like that! 
Windy-chan is totally different!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Just you watch!
Now I'm gonna pull an amazing 
prank that'll snatch everyone's attention
right up!

Shinko Windy declared boldly to the goat.
Perhaps because 
she sympathized with his plight,
she seemed surprisingly reliable—

A sudden thought hit me.
Couldn't we channel Windy's creativity
here? 
Her prank idea seemed a bit shortsighted,
so maybe—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Whaddya mean? 
Have Goat King help out with the prank...?
choice_data_list: He wants to stand out too

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm, yeah, I guess so... 
Pulling off pranks really does feel
awesome!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Alright, get ready, Goat King! 
Windy-chan's prank is gonna blow everyone
away!

text_block_list.name: Goat King
text_block_list.text: Meh-meeeeh?

text_block_list.name: Customers
text_block_list.text:
Now then, where should we head next? 
Looks like the giraffes and rhinos are over
there—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Wah-ha-ha-ha!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Goat King! All your food has now fallen 
into the clutches of the great Windy-sama!
choice_data_list: How dastardly! As expected of Wind...

text_block_list.name: Zookeeper
text_block_list.text:
That girl!
I only looked away for a second...! 
I'm so sorry, Goat King!

text_block_list.name: Customers
text_block_list.text:
—W-What are they doing? 
—They're right by that steep cliff!

text_block_list.name: Customers
text_block_list.text:
—Did she snatch the goat's food? 
—Oh, how pitiful...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ha-ha-ha! 
Too bad for you, Goat King!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
If only you had more strength,
you could take it back, huh? 
Must be so frustrating being this weak~!

text_block_list.name: Goat King
text_block_list.text: Meeh... Meeeeeh...

text_block_list.name: Goat King
text_block_list.text: Meeeeeeeeeeeeh!

text_block_list.name: Visitor C
text_block_list.text: Whoa?! That goat is scaling the cliff!

text_block_list.name: Visitor A
text_block_list.text:
Climbing up all of a sudden like that,
is he gonna be okay?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wha-?! He's actually climbing it...
*Ahem*! 
What formidable leg strength you possess!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I'll let you join Windy-chan's gang! 
Here's your reward!

text_block_list.name: Customers
text_block_list.text:
—Goat King is amazing! 
—Windy-chan, did you plan this all along?!

text_block_list.name: Customers
text_block_list.text:
—That was awesome! 
—Do it again!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
An encore, you say?! 
Wahahaha! Well, guess it can't be helped~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Next up,
feast your eyes on Windy-chan's might! 
Goat King, show 'em something even wilder!

text_block_list.name: Goat King
text_block_list.text: Meeeeeh! Meeeeeh!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Kuuu~~~~~! 
Man, that felt ridiculously good--!

text_block_list.name: Zookeeper
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, really! 
Goat King got so many visitors,
and he looked genuinely happy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
See ya, Goat King! 
You've finally got your big break,
so make the most of it!

We left the zoo and headed back to the academy.
On the way 
back,
Shinko Windy occasionally gazed up at the
evening sky.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Everyone gathered around, didn't they?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Windy-chan being amazing is totally normal,
though. 
That's just standard business. ...Still...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...pranks, huh.

Seeing her profile bathed in the sunset
glow, 
she looked a little more grown-up than
usual.
